Woof Woof #dogecoin

@CredibleCrypto I get shorting other memes like say $WIF or $BONK that have 50-100x'ed off their bear market lows, but shorting $DOGE after a mere 2x off it's multi year lows bc "memes have run too far too fast" doesn't quite make the same sense to me...🤷‍♂️

@Web3Quant @CredibleCrypto who I believe you follow and respect (as do I) is calling for a “meme apocalypse” where memes fall 70-80+% here soon with $Doge Leading the way. So it’s encouraging to hear your thoughts like this

@theunipcs @thedefivillain Nice to see your conviction still going strong. I’ll admit I’ve questioned mine a few times this last week. Been Wondering if I’m crazy to have most of my portfolio still in $BONK $DOGE $SHIB 🤷🏻‍♂️
